candidate.title: Act-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina Act-Seq schematic: a tissue slice passes through cell dissociation and actinomycin D treatment, then a Drop-Seq component co-encapsulates cells and barcoded oligobeads, lyses cells and captures poly(A) RNA, breaks droplets and pools beads, and yields sequencing-ready cDNA. Drop-Seq is an embedded component of Act-Seq, not an alternative target workflow. Act-seq in the primary abstract is the same method-name spelling variant. The far-left cell-to-RNA icon is interpreted as an analyte overview rather than a second material branch. The literal Frozen tissue slice label is retained without establishing a validated frozen-tissue implementation. The conflicting nuclei caption is resolved in correction c_cells; the drawn whole-cell route is retained. Primary-paper support admitted here is the supplied abstract, separately distinguished from PubMed metadata and secondary catalogue evidence. No unshown adaptation or internal library-preparation sequence is added.

operations.description: Transform the depicted tissue slice into dissociated, actinomycin-D-treated single cells. This combined operation preserves the captioned sequence without adding an unshown dissociation recipe.
